reviewItem.question: Does "loki Ruler: Add support for filtering results of `/prometheus/api/v1/rules` endpoint by rule_name, rule_group, file and type" mean a change to api-endpoint:loki|name=GET /prometheus/api/v1/rules|component=ruler (added)?

proposed.statement: The Loki Ruler endpoint GET /prometheus/api/v1/rules gains support for filtering results by rule_name, rule_group, file and type.
